name: FLIXO Background Remover opens as a standalone manual browser tool
description: The Background Remover must be reachable directly as a standalone local tool without requiring an agent or chat workflow.

planSteps.description: Verify the Background Remover tool page loads successfully.
Verify the page provides a direct manual image upload or file-selection control for the tool.
Verify the tool can be used from this standalone page without opening or confirming an agent chat.
Verify no agent execution control is required to begin the Background Remover workflow.
